slides.title: Tigray families fear executions abroad
slides.body: Ethiopians on death row in Saudi Arabia
Ethiopians sentenced to death in Saudi Arabia for drug trafficking, most from Tigray, a Tigray youth official said. Not independently verified.
Ethiopians executed in Saudi Arabia so far in 2026, according to an AFP tally of official statements.

slides.title: Trials without lawyers, official says
slides.body: The official said most were tried without a lawyer or interpreter, some after being deceived by brokers. Families fear more executions.

slides.title: Fair trials. Protect migrants.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard, Nov 16, 2026; AFP, Nov 12, 2026
